rule:
The test-period read for a batch sweep -- by a rule written before looking, with no judgement in it.

From ``runs/<fid>/sweep_<tag>.json`` (train / valid only) it picks, mechanically:

* ``v_base`` (the original) and ``k_known`` (the known-family benchmark), always;
* the best variant of each of the 3 best KINDS (structure / leaf / memory / shape / neutral /
  hypothesis ...), ranked by pure-long Sharpe on the user's training period, among variants that
  pass the gates (cov >= 0.95, dist >= 0.5) and whose long leg is positive on BOTH train and valid;
* the two best candidates BUILT ON the known family (overlays, screens, or any hypothesis that contains
  it) -- reported apart, because they are the known family plus a tilt or minus a screen;
* ``k_known_xfrozen``, the generic screen (known family, never the frozen-quote names), as their benchmark.

Only these are scored on the holdout (the user's test period), in the user's convention: sign and
half-life fitted on the user's training period, pure long book net of 15 bp.  The read is ledgered.

v_base.expr: ts_mean(sub(div(div(day_sum(select_where(is_gt(sub(div(Close, in_delay(Close, 5)), create_like(Close, 1)), day_quantile(Ret, 0.95)), sub(div(Close, in_delay(Close, 5)), create_like(Close, 1)), create_like(Close, 0))), add(day_sum(is_gt(sub(div(Close, in_delay(Close, 5)), create_like(Close, 1)), day_quantile(Ret, 0.95))), create_like(day_quantile(Ret, 0.95), 1e-06))), add(day_quantile(Ret, 0.95), create_like(day_quantile(Ret, 0.95), 1e-06))), div(div(day_sum(select_where(is_lt(sub(div(Close, in_delay(Close, 5)), create_like(Close, 1)), day_quantile(Ret, 0.05)), abs_(sub(div(Close, in_delay(Close, 5)), create_like(Close, 1))), create_like(Close, 0))), add(day_sum(is_lt(sub(div(Close, in_delay(Close, 5)), create_like(Close, 1)), day_quantile(Ret, 0.05))), create_like(day_quantile(Ret, 0.05), 1e-06))), add(abs_(day_quantile(Ret, 0.05)), create_like(day_quantile(Ret, 0.05), 1e-06)))), 20)

k_known_xfrozen.why: 已知族 + 剔除近 15 日冻结盘口最重的 20%(通用筛子基准)
